app.name: BusBondhu Express
app.tagline: Trust & Dispatch Layer for Intercity Bus Parcels
app.disclaimer: Prototype demo. Simulated data. No real parcels, payments or SMS.

landing.heroTitle: Intercity Bus Parcels, Built on Custody & Proof.
landing.heroSubtitle: Wholesalers and retailers restock faster with verified departures, upfront prices, digital handover scans, and secret receiver collection codes.

journey.step1Desc: Merchant selects scheduled departure and gets fixed upfront price.
journey.step2Desc: Origin counter scans parcel QR, verifies band weight and condition.
journey.step3Desc: Parcel assigned to verified bus manifest with departure cutoff lock.
journey.step4Desc: Luggage boot loaded. Supervisor marks departure scan.
journey.step5Desc: Unloaded at destination counter into secure storage holding.
journey.step6Desc: Receiver alerted via SMS with unique 6-digit pickup code.
journey.step7Desc: Code verified at counter before release. Settlement completed.
